source: Maryland Comptroller 2026 withholding formula (MW 507 basis, reproduced in NFC bulletin NFC-26-1783003892, eff. pay period 12-2026): standard deduction $3,400; exemption allowance $3,200 each; no withholding under $5,000/yr; graduated 4.75%–6.50% tables (6.25%/6.50% high-income brackets added for 2026). CLOSEST-FIT EXCEPTION: Maryland COUNTY income tax (2.25%–3.30% + Anne Arundel/Frederick graduated tables) is NOT modeled — local tax is out of ticket scope, so real Maryland net withholding will be materially higher; employers must add county tax outside this engine.
